---
title: Gerrymandering Metrics
format: typst
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

# Read the RAW precinct-level data directly
# (make sure this path matches your repo: usually "data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")
g24_raw <- readr::read_csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv")

# Do minimal cleaning here so this document is self-contained
g24_clean <- g24_raw |>
  # keep only 2024 general election, precinct-level rows
  filter(ELECTION == "g24", GEO_TYPE == "svprec") |>
  # drop statewide summary rows where district is 0
  filter(CDDIST != 0) |>
  # make vote columns numeric and replace NAs with 0
  mutate(
    CNGDEM01 = replace_na(as.numeric(CNGDEM01), 0),
    CNGDEM02 = replace_na(as.numeric(CNGDEM02), 0),
    CNGREP01 = replace_na(as.numeric(CNGREP01), 0),
    CNGREP02 = replace_na(as.numeric(CNGREP02), 0)
  )

# Build district-level results for the 2024 congressional map
cng_2024 <- g24_clean |>
  group_by(CDDIST) |>
  summarise(
    dem_votes  = sum(CNGDEM01 + CNGDEM02, na.rm = TRUE),
    rep_votes  = sum(CNGREP01 + CNGREP02, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_votes = dem_votes + rep_votes,
    dem_share  = dem_votes / (dem_votes + rep_votes),
    rep_share  = rep_votes / (dem_votes + rep_votes),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Function: mean–median score (Democratic vote share)
mean_median_score <- function(dem_share) {
  mean(dem_share) - median(dem_share)
}

# Function: efficiency gap
# EG = (wasted_D - wasted_R) / total_votes
# positive EG => Republican advantage
efficiency_gap <- function(dem_votes, rep_votes) {
  total      <- dem_votes + rep_votes
  half_plus1 <- floor(total / 2) + 1

  dem_wasted <- ifelse(
    dem_votes > rep_votes,
    dem_votes - half_plus1,  # wins
    dem_votes                # losses
  )

  rep_wasted <- ifelse(
    rep_votes > dem_votes,
    rep_votes - half_plus1,  # wins
    rep_votes                # losses
  )

  tibble(
    total_dem_wasted = sum(dem_wasted),
    total_rep_wasted = sum(rep_wasted),
    efficiency_gap   = (total_dem_wasted - total_rep_wasted) / sum(total)
  )
}
